context: A police officer briefs a manager on a joint protocol
purpose: Teach: 久保/浩/茂/竹内/後藤/従い/プロトコル/函

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社久保部長、浩課長、ご紹介ありがとうございました。
lines.en: Director Kubo, Section-Chief Hiroshi—thank you for the introduction.
lines.style: Formal but warm opening. Measured cadence, clear diction. A slight nod in the voice on the names—respect without stiffness. Steady eye contact level. Professional but human.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こちらこそ。茂さん、竹内さん、後藤さんも紹介できて何よりです。
lines.en: The pleasure is ours. I'm glad we could introduce Shigeru, Takeuchi, and Goto as well.
lines.style: Genuine warmth beneath the courtesy. Slight lift on 「こちらこそ」 energy—a small gesture of reciprocal goodwill. Open, collaborative tone. Relaxed but attentive.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察と御社の合同プロトコル、新指針に従い、運用を始めます。
lines.en: We'll launch the joint police-firm protocol following the new guidelines.
lines.style: Crisp, official delivery. Each phrase lands with quiet authority—no rushing. Steady breath, no theatricality. The voice of someone comfortable stating protocol without needing to defend it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 函館支店、地域での運用も歩調を合わせます。
lines.en: The Hakodate branch will align our regional operations with yours.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact affirmation. Calm, confident. Brief—no elaboration needed. A small beat of assurance: we are synchronized. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: よろしくお願いします。
lines.en: I look forward to working together.
lines.style: Formal close. Slight warmth beneath the ceremony—not perfunctory. A breath of genuine courtesy. Respectful finality without coldness.
